items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Did you know him? Sure, very well.

ctx.x: Ranked himself to death. Was he very heavy, fast by the time you saw him?

By the time I saw him I didn't know him any other way. Yeah. When he came to Scarborough he was a pretty big guy and he got larger still. Gin. That was a sight to see though. The average person didn't know him, thought he was drinking water. He got a pitcher full of gin. He got these cups that are using the drugs don't they put the cup in? Yeah. He took his picture and set it down. Water, they could see the color of it coming out of the picture. And then when he got to the place where he had a bottle of gin he…
Sure. Did you know him? Sure, very well. Now how would his playing compare with your playing at that time? You mean violin? Yeah.
